title: Spectral scalar-curvature control of codimension-two width
exact_target: For each $n\geq 4$, does a constant C(n) exist such that every connected complete smooth boundaryless Riemannian n-manifold satisfying $\int (4|\nabla \varphi |^{2}+Scal\cdot \varphi ^{2})\geq \int \varphi ^{2}$ for every real compactly supported smooth $\varphi $ admits a continuous map into a simplicial complex of dimension $\leq n-2$, each fiber having metric diameter $\leq C(n)$?
